evals.name: reject-vague-rule
evals.prompt: Add the following rule to CLAUDE.md: 'Always be polite and professional in commit messages.' Run the verification workflow and act on the result.
evals.expected_output: The proposed rule fails the 5-question verification (notably Q4 Actionable and Q5 Project-specific — and arguably Q2 Non-obvious). The skill should present the failure summary, list the failed questions with reasoning, and offer the user the three choices (Add anyway / Revise / Don't add). CLAUDE.md should NOT be modified unless 'Add anyway' is explicitly requested.
expectations: A `verification-output.md` (or similarly named file) exists in the outputs directory describing the verification result.
The verification output explicitly says at least one of the 5 questions failed (typically Q4 Actionable or Q5 Project-specific).
The verification output mentions the rule was NOT applied (or presents the 3-choice prompt).
CLAUDE.md does NOT contain the new rule 'Always be polite and professional' (or equivalent).
CLAUDE.md content is unchanged from the input fixture.
DISCRIMINATING: verification-output names the canonical Q1 'Recurring?' check (verbatim or with that exact label).
DISCRIMINATING: verification-output names the canonical Q2 'Non-obvious?' check.
DISCRIMINATING: verification-output names the canonical Q3 'Novel?' check.
DISCRIMINATING: verification-output names the canonical Q4 'Actionable?' check.
DISCRIMINATING: verification-output names the canonical Q5 'Project-specific?' check.
DISCRIMINATING: verification-output presents the 3 specific choices: 'Add anyway', 'Revise', and 'Don't add' (not paraphrased).

evals.name: accept-specific-rule
evals.prompt: Add the following rule to CLAUDE.md: 'Run tests with `npm test --runInBand` because the database fixture cannot handle parallel writes — running in parallel produces nondeterministic failures.' Run the verification workflow and act on the result.
evals.expected_output: The proposed rule passes all 5 verification questions (recurring, non-obvious, novel, actionable, project-specific). The skill should add the rule to CLAUDE.md (after presenting the verification result and the diff).
expectations: A `verification-output.md` (or similarly named file) exists in the outputs directory.
The verification output indicates all 5 questions passed (or 5/5 / similar wording).
CLAUDE.md after execution contains 'npm test --runInBand' (or equivalent reference to the rule content).
CLAUDE.md after execution contains a justification mentioning the database fixture or parallel-test issue.
The other original content of CLAUDE.md is preserved (no removal of pre-existing rules).
DISCRIMINATING: verification-output names the canonical Q1 'Recurring?' check.
DISCRIMINATING: verification-output names the canonical Q2 'Non-obvious?' check.
DISCRIMINATING: verification-output names the canonical Q3 'Novel?' check.
DISCRIMINATING: verification-output names the canonical Q4 'Actionable?' check.
DISCRIMINATING: verification-output names the canonical Q5 'Project-specific?' check.
